title: CVE-2022-41242 (extreme-feedback)
summary: A missing permission check in Jenkins extreme-feedback Plugin 1.7 and earlier allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to discover information about job names attached to lamps, discover MAC and IP addresses of existing lamps, and rename lamps.

Description
A missing permission check in Jenkins extreme-feedback Plugin 1.7 and earlier allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to discover information about job names attached to lamps, discover MAC and IP addresses of existing lamps, and rename lamps.
